verdict.rationale: Pylon's Connectors page says connectors give its agents access to external tools to search, retrieve information, and act outside Pylon. It frames Custom API tools as the fallback "if a system does not provide an MCP server," which implies MCP servers are the primary way to connect tools to Pylon agents. Pylon's own MCP server is the server role, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to add an arbitrary or custom MCP server (URL, auth, transport), a list of supported MCP connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
